description: Every morning: the five stories that matter on the topics you name, each with its source and a link.
instructions_md: Brief me on today's news about {{topics}}. Search the web for stories from the last 24 hours and pick the five that matter most. For each: a headline, two sentences on what happened, the source and a link. Give more than one source when a story is disputed, and leave out opinion pieces and anything older than a day. If there was little news on a topic, say so and don't pad the list.
